_doc: Stills models for remote_stills_*.py, chosen by shots_to_jobs.py --model. Owner's rule (2026-11-25): step-distilled 'turbo' models are for drafts and layout only, never for anything that ships; their stills are stamped draft and render refuses them. 'default' is the model shots_to_jobs.py uses without --model. Every model here has commercially usable weights, with the licence read from its model card on the date given.
